body:
And to complete my previous comment: we had a discussion with @vvo on how to implement this widget. At first, I used the NumericRefinementList. But this widget needs a static list of ranges. So it would have required some changes on the connector side, to handle both statics and dynamics range computation. (There's also this issue about the naming of NumericRefinementList #1306)

But considering the new issue with default values for Range, maybe it would have been better to modify NumericRefinementList. Anyway, need your thoughts about that guys :)
